#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: x address, table address, tiles_base, tiles_extra, period.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto x_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr auto table_args = TensorAccessorArgs<x_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_x = 0, cb_table = 1;
    const uint32_t x_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t table_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t tiles_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t tiles_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t period = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = tiles_base + (core < tiles_extra ? 1 : 0);
    const uint32_t start = (core * tiles_base) + (core < tiles_extra ? core : tiles_extra);
    const auto x = TensorAccessor(x_args, x_addr, 2048);
    const auto table = TensorAccessor(table_args, table_addr, 4096);
    for (uint32_t done = 0; done < count; done += 4) {
        const uint32_t n = (count - done) < 4 ? count - done : 4;
        cb_reserve_back(cb_x, 4);
        const uint32_t x_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_x);
        cb_reserve_back(cb_table, 4);
        const uint32_t table_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_table);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const uint32_t t = start + done + i;
            noc_async_read_page(t, x, x_ptr + i * 2048);
            noc_async_read_page(t % period, table, table_ptr + i * 4096);
        }
        noc_async_read_barrier();
        cb_push_back(cb_x, 4);
        cb_push_back(cb_table, 4);
    }
}
